responsibility: Supplies a handwritten dummy SYSTEM module implementation for the mc boot environment, containing only empty module initialization and finalization entry points needed for linkage. Unlike the SYSTEM header, it does not implement bit-set shift or rotate helpers and exists purely as scaffold code for the boot runtime.
same_name_distinction: Unlike GSYSTEM.h, this .cc file does not provide the SYSTEM bit-set shift/rotate API at all; it is only a handwritten boot-time stub with empty _M2_SYSTEM_init and _M2_SYSTEM_finish functions used for linkage in pge-boot.
